story.title: A Lifelong Love for Dogs
story.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Yakir Lavi, and my passion for dog training began over a decade ago. What started as an interest in basic obedience quickly evolved into a deep commitment to classical training methods and the competitive world of IGP (Internationale Gebrauchshunde Prüfung) dog sport.
story.paragraph2: For the past 8 years, I've dedicated myself to mastering IGP training - a demanding sport that tests a dog's tracking abilities, obedience precision, and protection work. This journey has taken me to the highest levels of competition, including the IGP World Championship in 2023.
story.paragraph3: My competitive achievements include 2nd place at the Israel National Championship in 2023, followed by 4th place in 2024 and 5th place in 2025. These competitions aren't just about winning - they're about demonstrating the incredible results that come from structured, classical training methods.
story.paragraph4: Over 10 years of experience, I've trained more than 500 dogs - from family companions needing reliable obedience to working dogs preparing for competitions. I believe in clear communication, consistent structure, and helping every dog reach its full potential through proven training techniques.
story.quote: My mission is to unlock every dog's potential through classical training methods. Whether you want a reliable family companion or a competitive sport dog, I provide the structure, discipline, and expertise to achieve real results.
